projectSummary: Direct mechanical evidence that the pectoralis major does not act as a single unit: its sub-regions have significantly different leverage at the glenohumeral joint. Abstract-only, so no millimetre value is carried forward.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Cadaveric, eight specimens, abstract-only. Moment arm is leverage, not force or activation.

study.intervention: Cadaveric tendon-excursion measurement of instantaneous moment arms.
study.population: Instantaneous moment arms of 18 major muscle sub-regions crossing the glenohumeral joint were measured by the tendon-excursion method in eight entire upper-extremity cadaver specimens, during coronal-plane abduction and sagittal-plane flexion.

title: Moment arms of the muscles crossing the anatomical shoulder.
